create_augment_image_rotate: create a Rotate augmentation that applies random rotation angles to images and masks
create_augment_image_resize: create a Resize augmentation that randomly resizes images and masks within a size range
create_augment_image_crop: create a Crop augmentation that randomly crops images and masks to a specified size range
create_augment_image_perspective: create a Perspective augmentation that applies random perspective distortion to images and masks
create_augment_image_horizontal_flip: create a HorizontalFlip augmentation that flips images and masks horizontally
